channel.title: Tejas Mahajan — Blog
channel.description: Technical notes on biology, chemistry, industry biochem, computer architecture, quant trading, and machine learning, by Tejas Mahajan.

item.title: Bonding, energy, and the thermodynamics behind molecular modeling
item.description: A primer on chemical bonds, conformational energy, and free energy — the ideas a computational model is approximating when it tries to say whether a molecule is stable or whether two molecules will bind.

item.title: Limit order books and the microstructure under a trade
item.description: How a limit order book works, what price-time priority means, and why the shape of the book matters for how prices actually move — with a pointer to a small educational order-book demo I built.

item.title: How machine learning shows up in a drug discovery pipeline
item.description: A map of a standard small-molecule discovery pipeline, the jobs machine learning is actually asked to do along it, and a short look at related formulation problems in areas such as cosmetics.

item.title: From the central dogma to single-cell sequencing
item.description: A short explainer of how information flows from DNA to RNA to protein, why bulk measurements average away cell differences, and what a single-cell experiment actually produces.

item.title: Why synthetic data can still leak private records
item.description: A walkthrough of SyntheticShield, a research prototype that audits synthetic-data generators for memorization and membership leakage using canary records and membership tests.

item.title: How RAGGuard filters sensitive context before it reaches the model
item.description: A walkthrough of RAGGuard, a research prototype that sits between a retriever and a generator, classifies each chunk, and measures leakage against an unfiltered RAG baseline.

item.title: QoS-aware memory scheduling for CPU–AI co-execution
item.description: How FairDRAM, a research prototype built on Ramulator 2, gives latency-sensitive CPU requests bounded priority when an accelerator is flooding memory bandwidth.
